name: Beary the Hatchet
source:
It's Halloween 199X, and you killed someone during your morning shift.

Honestly it's inconvenient. This job was imperfect, sure, but you got to wear a mask with no questions asked and the pay was livable. But now you'll have to keep the body in the backrooms till your shift is done. Bummer.

[i]"You're... the absolutely WICKED and AWESOME Bearwater Grizzly Killer, aren't you?!"[/i]

...and now enters the dreaded true crime fan.

A game about hiding things.

[from [url=https://mokadevs.itch.io/beary-the-hatchet]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
那是199年的万圣节，你在早班时杀了人。

说实话很不方便。当然，这份工作并不完美，但你必须戴上口罩，不问任何问题，而且薪水还可以。但现在你必须把尸体放在后面的房间里，直到你的轮班结束。真糟糕。

[i]“你是……绝对邪恶和令人敬畏的熊水灰熊杀手，不是吗？！”[/i]

…现在进入可怕的真正犯罪迷。

一款关于隐藏事物的游戏。

[来自[url=https://mokadevs.itch.io/beary-the-hatchet]itch.io[/url]]
